label: canon-c205-in13-n2
_why: THE LOOP'S SECOND PICK (2026-09-15; the standing loop: report -> clock -> the best new config). The x1.3 lift at C 1.9 (canon-c19-in13, session 20260915_002935) removed the unlifted book's 1870-1900 dip and then ran away - 0.97 / 1.08 / 1.16 / 1.36x vanilla's median at 1880 / 1890 / 1900 / 1910 in its first run (the C 1.6 shape, earlier) - so the lift is a strong lever on the loop's gain in the MORE-GDP direction: making rung 0 loss-making pushes construction to the frontier sooner, and at C 1.9 the frontier's capital is cheap enough for that to compound. To kill rung 0 WITHOUT the runaway the lift needs a dearer frontier: this book keeps the x1.3 lift and moves the slope to 2.05 - between C 1.9 x1.3 (runaway) and C 2.2 x1.2 (F113: 0.65x, the frontier too scarce), where the lift's push should lift a stalling world toward the band while the dearer frontier stops it compounding. Everything else as canon-c19-in13 (A 2.2 / B 1.5, ai_value 3^era, divisor 0.000125, the defines, the 24-month bar). One lever against canon-c19-in13 (the slope). If it lands in the band with rung 0 dead, it is the canon candidate; if it stalls, the lift is not the lever for goal 3 at any slope and the found config stays canon-c19-in12.
